controles.affirmation: Action du ministere americain de la justice deposee en juin 2024 sur saisine de la FTC, reprochant a Adobe de ne pas divulguer clairement ses conditions et de ne pas offrir un mecanisme de resiliation simple.
controles.verbatim_source: The FTC then referred the case to the Department of Justice (the "DOJ"), and on June 17, 2024, the DOJ filed a civil complaint in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California ... The complaint alleges that Adobe failed to clearly and conspicuously disclose material terms, failed to obtain express informed consent and failed to provide a simple cancellation mechanism ... in violation of ROSCA and the FTC Act.

controles.affirmation: La demande de rejet d'Adobe a ete refusee par le tribunal le 2 mai 2025 et l'affaire s'est reglee par accord le 12 mars 2026, avec des charges comptabilisees au premier semestre 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: On May 2, 2025, the Court denied our motion to dismiss the complaint, and discovery then ensued. On March 12, 2026, we reached an agreement to settle the action ... During the six months ended May 29, 2026, we also incurred loss contingencies associated with a legal settlement and other legal matters.

controles.affirmation: Cinq actions derivees restent en cours avec une plainte modifiee deposee le 16 mars 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: On July 11, 2025, the Sbriglio and Daniel Actions were consolidated, and plaintiffs filed an amended complaint on March 16, 2026. ... The Derivative Actions are presently stayed.
controles.correction_proposee: Le nombre (cinq actions nommees) et la date d'amendement sont exacts, mais le document precise que ces actions sont suspendues, ce que l'ATT omet alors que c'est une nuance qui affaiblit l'argument. Formulation correcte : "cinq actions derivees restent pendantes, actuellement suspendues, avec une plainte modifiee deposee le 16 mars 2026". Preciser aussi que Shah/Gervat et Sbriglio/Daniel ont ete consolidees.

controles.affirmation: L'action collective boursiere liee a Figma a ete rejetee et le rejet fait l'objet d'un appel.
controles.verbatim_source: We filed a motion to dismiss the Securities Action, which was granted in full on March 27, 2025. Plaintiff sought leave to amend the complaint in response to the court's order, which the court denied on November 7, 2025. Plaintiff is appealing the court's orders.

controles.affirmation: Adobe indique etre soumise au reglement europeen sur l'IA, dont les obligations se deploient par phases jusqu'en 2030 et prevoient des amendes administratives.
controles.verbatim_source: obligations under the EU AI Act have gone into effect and will continue to be implemented in phases through 2030 ... Non-compliant companies under the EU AI Act may be subject to administrative fines.

controles.affirmation: Fusion des trois segments en un seul au T1 FY2026 ; dernier ARR Digital Media publie 19,2 Mds$ au T4 FY2025.
controles.verbatim_source: In the first quarter of fiscal 2026, we combined our former segments ... into a single operating and reportable segment (10-Q T2 FY2026) ; "Digital Media ARR grew to $19.20 billion at the end of fiscal 2025" (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Resultat net 1,71 Md$ quasi stable (+1,2%) pour un CA en hausse de 13% ; charges d'exploitation 3 665 M$ contre 3 126 M$ (+17%) dont frais generaux 546 M$ contre 377 M$ (+45%) ; marge d'exploitation de 35,9% a 33,8% ; marge nette 25,9% ; marge brute 89,2%.
controles.verbatim_source: Net income of $1.71 billion during the three months ended May 29, 2026 remained relatively flat compared to the year-ago period. ; Total revenue 6,618 / 5,873 ; Net income 1,712 / 1,691 ; Total operating expenses 3,665 / 3,126 ; General and administrative 546 / 377 ; Operating income 2,238 / 2,109 ; Gross profit 5,903

controles.affirmation: ARR total 27,10 Mds$ (+12,5%) dont environ 480 M$ apportes par Semrush, acquise 1,87 Md$ le 28 avril 2026 ; goodwill 14,04 Mds$ contre 12,86 Mds$, avec une depreciation de 70 M$ sur Publishing & Advertising.
controles.verbatim_source: Total Adobe ARR grew to $27.10 billion ... including approximately $480 million from the Semrush acquisition ; On April 28, 2026, we completed the acquisition of Semrush ... for $1.87 billion, primarily in cash consideration ; Goodwill as of May 29, 2026 and November 28, 2025 was $14.04 billion and $12.86 billion, respectively ... partially offset by a goodwill impairment charge of $70 million associated with our Publishing & Advertising reporting unit

controles.affirmation: 4,589 Mds$ de rachats d'actions au premier semestre contre 3,601 Mds$ de resultat net (127%) ; capitaux propres 11 518 M$ contre 11 623 M$ ; tresorerie 5 431 -> 4 919 M$ ; 500 M$ de billets de tresorerie ; 399 millions d'actions contre 413 millions ; rachats en baisse de 32% par rapport a 6 750 M$.
controles.verbatim_source: Repurchases of common stock (4,589) / (6,750) ; Net income 3,601 ; 399 and 413 shares outstanding, respectively ; As of May 29, 2026, we had $500 million of commercial paper outstanding ... As of November 28, 2025, there were no outstanding borrowings under the commercial paper program.

controles.affirmation: 1 043 M$ de remuneration en actions au S1 FY2026, 4,21 Mds$ de cout non comptabilise a etaler sur 2,55 ans ; demande d'augmentation de la reserve du plan de 12 millions d'actions.
controles.verbatim_source: As of May 29, 2026, there was $4.21 billion of unrecognized compensation cost ... which will be recognized over a weighted average period of 2.55 years ; "Approve the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended, to increase the available share reserve by 12 million shares" (DEF 14A)

controles.affirmation: Transition de direction generale non bouclee : les protections de la directrice juridique prennent fin 12 mois apres l'entree en fonction du nouveau directeur general (8-K du 17 juillet 2026, evenement du 14 juillet 2026).
controles.verbatim_source: On July 14, 2026, the Executive Compensation Committee ... approved entering into a form of retention letter with Louise Pentland ... The severance protections set forth in the Retention Letter are designed to be temporary in nature and will sunset 12 months following the date the new Chief Executive Officer commences employment with the Company

controles.affirmation: Environ 80% des voix exprimees ont approuve la remuneration des dirigeants a l'assemblee 2025 ; remuneration du directeur general 51 173 935 $ contre 235 989 $ pour le salarie median, ratio de 217 pour 1.
controles.verbatim_source: At our 2025 annual meeting of stockholders, approximately 80% of the votes cast approved, on an advisory basis, the fiscal year 2024 compensation for our named executive officers ; The fiscal year 2025 annual total compensation of our CEO was $51,173,935 and the annual total compensation of our median compensated employee was $235,989 ... a ratio of 217 to 1

controles.affirmation: ARR IA-first superieur a 500 M$ et Firefly proche de 300 M$.
controles.verbatim_source: AI-first ARR triples year over year and exceeds $500 million (communique du 11 juin 2026) ; Firefly ending ARR, including Firefly apps and credit plans and Enterprise Firefly offerings, approaching $300 million (remarques preparees du 11 juin 2026)
